title.zh: GPT-Synopsys: Frontier Intelligence to Revolutionize Chip Design
title.en: GPT-Synopsys: Frontier Intelligence to Revolutionize Chip Design

current_state.zh: OpenAI and Synopsys announced GPT-Synopsys, a specialized frontier model built on Synopsys EDA technology that lets engineers delegate chip-design objectives to agents that run tools, interpret results, and iterate toward verified outcomes.
